lineage.v1_1_change: editorial micro-motion adjustments in windows beginning at 33.1, 40.6, 41.5 and 46.5 seconds; base creative content unchanged
lineage.rule: A V1 fallback must be labeled as lineage fallback and independently verified; V1.1 remains primary. Re-encoding does not imply identical pixels.

authority.conflict_rule: An approved master is not blanket approval of every frame. Exclude individual blurry, corrupted, anatomically defective or text-overlapped frames from golden promotion.

golden_reference_policy.source_rule: Extract lossless frames and high-quality excerpts only from original approved masters or original artifacts; previews/thumbnails cannot become golden authority.
motion_qa: watch full excerpt at native 1x speed
golden_reference_policy.no_false_pass: Metadata, old approval or prompt text cannot substitute for current pixel/motion inspection. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.

camera_grammar.gentle_tracking_condition: only if necessary for the educational action and supported by source geometry
camera_grammar.teaching_rule: Keep all critical educational objects fully readable and reserve caption space throughout the trajectory.

motion_grammar.secondary_motion: Explicitly bounded natural micro-motion only, never a second teaching action or a new object transition.
motion_grammar.pacing: natural real-time 1x motion; normal conversational gesture and blink timing
forbidden: freeze pose used to fill narration
motion_grammar.pedagogical_pause: A deliberate 2.5-second response window retains subtle life; pause is timing, never a visible technical label.

shot_contract.binding: Bind approved original source SHA and golden reference SHAs before dispatch; generation can never substitute an experimental source silently.

provider_policy.preferred_lineage: Use the same tier that produced approved five-eggs clips unless evidence proves another tier is necessary.

local_code_evidence.scope: Current local pilot code configuration; not a historical provider receipt and not a current price quote

provider_policy.quality_principle: Source, contract and review determine quality first; Pro is not a quality prerequisite.

prompt_compiler.same_input_rule: Same versioned canonical inputs produce byte-identical prompt and SHA; compilation performs no provider/network action.

pre_provider_storyboard.readability: Each shot must be understandable before animation.
pre_provider_storyboard.preview_label: A storyboard preview is for review; provider input still binds the approved original bytes.
pre_provider_storyboard.gate: Missing previews, costs, inventories or end states block execution, even when six contract templates exist.

educational_graphics.geometry_rule: Use exact local vectors for clean educational shapes; do not spend retries to correct simple geometry.
educational_graphics.color_rule: Explicit stable color tokens, mask-constrained correction and tracked object identity; retain shading/material texture. Do not tint Lumi or the entire garden.
educational_graphics.occlusion_rule: Use validated masks, tracking, depth/occlusion order and contact shadows so local elements coexist with Lumi and scene perspective. Composite cannot hide broken anatomy or invent missing source performance.
educational_graphics.caption_space: Reserve and verify safe regions at every frame; shorten, reposition or suppress optional text when needed. Required text with no safe region fails layout.
educational_graphics.source_invariant: Source object completeness must already support the planned performance; deterministic postproduction is not permission for missing required source objects.

defect_classes.LOCAL_DETERMINISTIC_REPAIR: An evidenced local color/geometry/text/layout/composite/timing correction can preserve identity, anatomy and educational meaning; re-review derivative.
defect_classes.HUMAN_WARNING: Minor preference or continuity deviation with no identity, teaching or safety failure; human review required, no automatic promotion.
defect_classes.GENERATION_FATAL: Unrecoverable identity/anatomy/style/performance/object failure after concrete local-salvage assessment; may justify a request, never automatic spending.

qa_policy.paid_regeneration: Only GENERATION_FATAL plus explicit human authorization specifying artifact, count and incremental/total budget permits a paid regeneration.
qa_policy.quality_waiver: Human warning cannot silently waive an exact count, semantic, anatomy or text-over-character invariant.
qa_policy.original_evidence: Preserve original automated QA, human history, artifacts, hashes, provider requests and costs; derivatives receive separate provenance.

economic_policy.formula: all attributable generation/repair/experiment costs in USD divided by number of technically and creatively approved clips
economic_policy.unknown_cost_behavior: UNRECONCILED; do not claim ceiling PASS
economic_policy.cumulative_preflight_formula: settled episode visual cost + unresolved cost upper bound + allocated experimental cost + quoted remaining calls + local paid processing, if any
economic_policy.credit_policy: Do not treat a credit as USD or an unknown credit charge as free; reconcile applied provider quote/conversion and settlement before PASS.

unreconciled_task_snapshot_from_parent_a.note: This is a documentary snapshot; exact provenance and latest settled values belong to the cost plan. No free remaining budget is asserted.

third_short_policy.source_audit: All six sources require evidence-based comparison against verified golden frames and Source Readiness V2. Unknown does not mean pass or regeneration required.
third_short_policy.q31: Preserve rejected q31; stop q31-PRO1. Assess local alignment first; if impossible, prepare exactly one canonical q31 source request with execution OFF.
